[TODO:es] Calm them and set the boundary

ascend_begin.text:

[TODO:es] Climb in trust toward His voice
[TODO:es] Rest halfway and wait for a sign

fear_consequence.text:

Fear has no place on this path.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Climb in trust toward His voice

delay_consequence.text:

choices.text: [TODO:es] Climb in trust toward His voice

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stand tall and meet His gaze

[TODO:es] Receive every word in silence

[TODO:es] Carry them down to the people
